en.name: GadgetNest
en.subtitle: Compare tech before you buy
en.short_description: Compare phones, laptops and parts on price and spec, and watch prices.
en.description:
GadgetNest is for the part of buying a gadget that happens before you buy it.

BROWSE AND COMPARE
Work through categories, open a product for its full specs, and put several side by side. GadgetNest marks which one is the better deal and says why.

PRICE HISTORY
A chart of what a product has cost over time, so "on sale" has to prove itself.

BUILD LIST
Collect the parts of a build in one list and keep the total in front of you.

SAVED
Keep the products you are still thinking about.

STRAIGHT ANSWERS
GadgetNest earns a commission on some outbound links. It does not reorder results because of it, and everything it stores stays on your device — there is no account and one button erases the lot.

review_information.notes:
No account, no sign-in, no permission prompts and no network required. The entire catalogue — 9 products across 9 retailers — is compiled into the app, so every screen works in airplane mode.

The prices, retailer offers and the price-history chart are modelled, not collected from retailers. A build that is allowed to display them carries a permanent "Sample prices — not live retailer data" strip above the tabs. If instead every price area shows a "Live prices are unavailable" card, the build was compiled without the sample-data flag and is refusing to show invented prices; browsing, specs, compare and saving all still work, and it is not a loading failure.

Worth exercising: open a product for its full specs and price chart, add two products to Compare, and use Build list to price a whole basket at a single retailer.

One thing that looks like a bug and is not: on some offers the text under the buy button reads "We earn nothing if you buy here. This retailer is not in any of our affiliate programmes." Micro Center and Apple are genuinely in no affiliate programme of ours, so those links carry no tracking parameter and say so. Buy buttons open the retailer in the external browser rather than a webview.

Saved products and the theme setting are stored on the device only.
